story: DeSoto State Park is a forest area located in Alabama, USA, covering 3,502 acres of forest, rivers, waterfalls, and mountain terrain on Lookout Mountain. Established in 1935, it features the 104-foot-tall DeSoto Falls and borders the Little River.
matters: The park borders the Little River, which flows into the nearby Little River Canyon National Preserve.
